title: Automated plan scorecards, policy scorecard comments, and safe rollforward playbook for VPC IaC CI
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Terraform plan outputs are hard to review in PRs for private (VPC) deployments, and current OPA/Conftest fails provide opaque errors. We need a CI artifact that summarizes plans, attaches a policy scorecard (per-rule scoring and rationale), and drives an automated safe rollforward playbook for upgrade PRs that affect critical networking resources.

Goal: Produce a machine-readable plan-summary + human-friendly policy scorecard artifact for every terraform plan in the CI pipeline. Gate PRs based on configurable thresholds (fail/warn), post the summary to GH PRs, and enable a documented 'safe rollforward' flow that can be followed by SRE when an upgrade is high-risk but meets defined mitigations (canary targets, immutable infra flags, manual approvals).

Why unique: Existing pipeline gates only fail/allow; this feature emphasizes visibility (scorecards), graded policy decisions, and a repeatable operational playbook for controlled rollforwards on private VPC stacks.
acceptance_criteria: CI produces a plan-summary JSON and an HTML policy scorecard artifact for every terraform plan
PR comment shows top-level plan delta (resources add/change/delete), severities, and per-rule score with links to Rego rule text
Conftest/OPA rules run in the pipeline and output a numeric score; pipeline fails if score < configured threshold (default 70)
Safe rollforward playbook documented in Confluence and linked in PR comment; automated canary apply job exists but requires Manual Approve workflow to run against canary-target workspace
Manual and automated tests validate state-lock failover behavior during plan/apply (simulated concurrent apply), with alerts created when lock contention > 90s
tasks: Create plan-summary generator step that parses terraform plan --out and terraform show -json into a compact summary (top 10 diffs by cost/impact)
Integrate Conftest with Rego rule library; convert existing policy checks (kms, public-subnet, flow-logs, s3-public-block) into scoreable rules
Add score aggregator that maps rule results to points (critical=0-40, high=0-30, medium=0-20, low=0-10) and produces overall percentage
Post formatted GH PR comment with summary, badge (PASS/WARN/FAIL), and link to static HTML scorecard artifact hosted in CI
Implement canary-apply workflow: create 'canary' Terraform workspace, restricted credentials, and manual approval gate in pipeline
Document safe rollforward playbook in Confluence and link from PR comment template
Add observability: expose plan durations, policy execution time, score distribution to internal dashboard (Datadog/Grafana)
implementation_notes:
Plan summary: we will invoke 'terraform plan -out=tfplan' then 'terraform show -json tfplan' and run a small Go utility (plan-summarizer) that extracts resource changes, provider, module path, and an estimated risk score (heuristics: net public IP delta, any replace operations on database subnet groups).

Policy scoring: rules authored in Rego; each rule annotates 'severity' and 'impact_points'. Conftest run produces a list of failures; our score aggregator reduces to percent = 100 - (sum(impact_points_failed) / sum(max_points) * 100). Default fail threshold is 70. The pipeline will expose both numeric score and human text recommendations for each failing rule.

GH integration: use the pipeline's github-action to post a PR comment with a short markdown summary and an artifacts URL. For failing-but-acceptable cases, the PR comment will include a 'Request safe rollforward' checklist that triggers an automated ticket template for SRE review.

State lock failover: we will add retries with increasing jitter to the apply step and capture detailed error metadata in Sentry when lock fails persist > 3 attempts. Add runbook steps for manual lock override (terraform force-unlock) restricted to infra-ops group.
ci_changes_required: Add plan-summarizer binary to runner images (build in infra-tools repo)
New 'policy-score' step after Conftest to compute and upload scorecard artifact
Create 'canary-apply' pipeline stage with manual approval; separate credentials for canary workspace
Add GH token with comment permissions scoped to only repo and pipeline-google-service-account for artifact upload
Pipeline templates: integrate with existing terraform-lint/tflint and tfsec steps, but skip tfsec for small module-only changes to reduce noise
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Scoring gives false negatives for benign infra churn -> Mitigation: provide explicit whitelist for acceptable deltas and a reviewer override that records rationale
Risk: Rego rules may be brittle across TF versions -> Mitigation: include semantic tests for rules against representative plan fixtures and run them in PRs for the policy repo
Risk: Large plans slow down CI -> Mitigation: plan-summarizer will truncate to top-10 high-impact changes and stream remainder to artifact storage; add pipeline timeout metrics
Risk: Misuse of force-unlock during incident -> Mitigation: only infra-ops role can run force-unlock; require two-person approval logged in Sentry and audit log
comments: 2025-02-12 Ava Chen: Created ticket after incident where a VPC change rolled out without clear risk summary. Initial proposal posted to Confluence.
2025-02-14 Marco Ruiz: Spike completed for plan-summarizer. Prototype extracts resource path and change type; storing sample artifact in pipeline-artifacts bucket (link in 'links').
2025-02-16 Lila Park (Review): Suggested mapping severity to human-readable remediation steps and adding a reviewer override flow. Also asked for audit entries when override used.
2025-02-18 Marco Ruiz: Implemented Conftest integration and created first Rego rule set (kms-required, s3-block-public). Running unit tests for rules; 95% pass on fixture plans.

2025-02-20 Owen Patel (Security): Approves approach but requests security_review_required flag. Recommended adding policy-change CI that prevents policy drift in production without a 2-approver merge in policy repo.
follow_up: Roll out policy score thresholds per-environment (prod=85, staging=70, dev=55)
Add automated remediation suggestions (tf import commands, module pinning hints) in scorecard
Run a cross-team tabletop for safe rollforward playbook and incorporate feedback into the runbook
